_note: siteUrl: the live address, e.g. https://www.example.com (used for the sitemap and canonical links; leave empty until the domain is live). dataVerified: true once broker figures in content/brokers.json have been checked against each broker's website (they were on 2026-09-29; see each broker's sources). Brokers whose own 'verified' flag is false still get a notice and noindex on their review page. guidesFcaOnly: when true, the 'best' guides and homepage top picks only rank FCA-authorised brokers (right for a UK audience); set false to rank every broker. featuredPartner: the broker id shown in a clearly labelled 'Featured partner' box at the top of the homepage and every guide (it must be FCA-authorised when guidesFcaOnly is true). Leave empty to turn the box off. It never changes scores or rankings. partnerOpinionPosts: false keeps partner (FxPro) opinion pieces such as 'Market Comment' off the site (they are still imported and kept in content/posts); set true once the partner has approved them for publication here. Factual partner posts (Weekly Performance) and official US data are always published.
